# Lore claims

<!-- Generated by `./gradlew :codex:lore --args=docs` from the files under lore/. Do not edit;
     LoreDocsTest fails the build when this page and the files disagree. -->

Community knowledge enters the project as one file per claim under `lore/<topic>/<id>.md`, with
its source, its variant, the version it names and the Tier the pinned code gives it
([ADR-0021](../adr/0021-lore-claim-format.md)). A claim is never a mechanic by itself: only a
heuristic that cites it, or a Rule that settles it, puts it into play. A claim is checked on
every build by `LoreCheck`.

Tier 1: the code confirms it. Tier 2: the harness confirms it. Tier 3: not settled by the code,
a hypothesis for the Rig. Tier F: the code contradicts it. A claim marked `needs-review` was
graded at an older tag and a line it cites reads differently at the pin.
